selection_notes: Exact user-supplied CWE IDs are preserved in request order; automatic limits and filters do not apply.

selected_checks.title: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)
selected_checks.plain_language_summary: The web application does not, or cannot, sufficiently verify whether a request was intentionally provided by the user who sent the request, which could have originated from an unauthorized actor.
selected_checks.why_it_matters: Potential consequences include Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability, Non-Repudiation, Access Control; Gain Privileges or Assume Identity, Bypass Protection Mechanism, Read Application Data, Modify Application Data, DoS: Crash, Exit, or Restart (Likelihood of Exploit: Medium)

selected_checks.title: Missing Authorization
selected_checks.plain_language_summary: The product does not perform an authorization check when an actor attempts to access a resource or perform an action.
selected_checks.why_it_matters: Potential consequences include Confidentiality; Read Application Data, Read Files or Directories; Integrity; Modify Application Data, Modify Files or Directories; Access Control; Gain Privileges or Assume Identity, Bypass Protection Mechanism; Availability; D. (Likelihood of Exploit: High)

selected_checks.title: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')
selected_checks.plain_language_summary: The web application accepts a user-controlled input that specifies a link to an external site, and uses that link in a redirect.
selected_checks.why_it_matters: Potential consequences include Access Control; Bypass Protection Mechanism, Gain Privileges or Assume Identity; Access Control, Confidentiality, Other; Bypass Protection Mechanism, Gain Privileges or Assume Identity, Other (Likelihood of Exploit: Low)

selected_checks.title: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
selected_checks.plain_language_summary: The product constructs all or part of a code segment using externally-influenced input from an upstream component, but it does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes special elements that could modify the syntax or behavior of the intended code segment.
selected_checks.why_it_matters: Potential consequences include Access Control; Bypass Protection Mechanism; Access Control; Gain Privileges or Assume Identity; Integrity, Confidentiality, Availability; Execute Unauthorized Code or Commands; Non-Repudiation; Hide Activities (Likelihood of Exploit: Medium)

selected_checks.title: Improper Neutralization of CRLF Sequences in HTTP Headers ('HTTP Request/Response Splitting')
selected_checks.plain_language_summary: The product receives data from an HTTP agent/component (e.g., web server, proxy, browser, etc.), but it does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes CR and LF characters before the data is included in outgoing HTTP headers.
selected_checks.why_it_matters: Potential consequences include Integrity, Access Control; Modify Application Data, Gain Privileges or Assume Identity

selected_checks.title: Improper Authentication
selected_checks.plain_language_summary: When an actor claims to have a given identity, the product does not prove or insufficiently proves that the claim is correct.
selected_checks.why_it_matters: Potential consequences include Integrity, Confidentiality, Availability, Access Control; Read Application Data, Gain Privileges or Assume Identity, Execute Unauthorized Code or Commands (Likelihood of Exploit: High)

selected_checks.title: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
selected_checks.plain_language_summary: The product deserializes untrusted data without sufficiently ensuring that the resulting data will be valid.
selected_checks.why_it_matters: Potential consequences include Integrity; Modify Application Data, Unexpected State; Availability; DoS: Resource Consumption (CPU); Other; Varies by Context (Likelihood of Exploit: Medium)

selected_checks.title: Inconsistent Interpretation of HTTP Requests ('HTTP Request/Response Smuggling')
selected_checks.plain_language_summary: The product acts as an intermediary HTTP agent (such as a proxy or firewall) in the data flow between two entities such as a client and server, but it does not interpret malformed HTTP requests or responses in ways that are consistent with how the messages wi.
selected_checks.why_it_matters: Potential consequences include Integrity, Non-Repudiation, Access Control; Unexpected State, Hide Activities, Bypass Protection Mechanism
